mpv — https://mpv.io
This folder contains mpv.exe (Windows build by shinchiro, v0.41.0), used by PlexPlayer
as its native video player. mpv is free software, licensed under the GNU General Public
License v2 or later (parts under the GNU LGPL v2.1 or later). Source code:
https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv   Windows builds: https://github.com/shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake
